issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that the Lecture constructor should take parameters in the attribute order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution's Lecture constructor uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch can confuse students when comparing the specification to the reference implementation and may cause tests or examples that assume the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order in the solution match the UML/problem statement. Change the constructor signature to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly. Alternatively, if the solution's ordering is intentional, update the problem statement/UML to reflect the constructor parameter order used in the reference implementation.
